# Early-export allocation, export, import and CPU-access contract

**AI disclosure:** This document, including its title and every word, was generated by AI.

This is the reviewed-contract deliverable for
[driver #90](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/90).
It is shared with
[companion #52](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/52).
It changes no advertised support tier, does not enable
`V4L2_MEMORY_FLAG_NON_COHERENT`, and does not close Chromium or CMA
qualification.

Merged [PR #92](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/pull/92)
(`3570a2e09d232a5a541c63df7d2cf699fa4b096b`) kept coherent early-export and
classified CREATE_BUFS `-ENOMEM` as `VA_STATUS_ERROR_ALLOCATION_FAILED`. The
flag-only non-coherent request in that PR's first head was rejected
([review 5241889096](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/pull/92#pullrequestreview-5241889096)).
This file records why, what remains legal, and what a later implementation
must prove before requesting cacheable backing.

## Decision

At companion kernel pin
[`94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/tree/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea),
**userspace must keep Chrome early-export CREATE_BUFS on coherent
`V4L2_MEMORY_MMAP`.** Capability advertisement, a count=0 CREATE_BUFS probe,
keeping the throwaway allocator fd open, refusing CPU maps, and
`DMA_BUF_IOCTL_SYNC` do **not** establish a CPU/importer contract for a
buffer that is exported, whose allocating queue is closed, and that the live
decoder then imports as DMABUF.

A future non-coherent or noncontiguous request is legal only after a
**separate experimental companion candidate** (not a shipped patch edit)
gives the exporter real CPU-access cache maintenance, or allocates
noncontiguous memory that is not cacheable-MMAP, and after offline
ordering tests against that new kernel identity. Coherent CREATE_BUFS
remains the required fallback whenever any of those conditions is missing.

This is not a CMA or Chromium playback fix. Capture-plane fragmentation
stays on companion #52. Guarded Chromium stays on driver #90 / companion #22.

## Path that exists today (accepted)

Chrome creates a VA surface, calls `vaExportSurfaceHandle()`, imports the
dma-buf into its GPU, then decodes. The driver must allocate standalone
CAPTURE backing **before** a decode context exists, then make the live
decoder write into that same memory.

1. `backing_alloc()` opens a throwaway decoder fd, sets CAPTURE format,
   issues `VIDIOC_CREATE_BUFS` with `count = 1` and `V4L2_MEMORY_MMAP`
   (no `V4L2_MEMORY_FLAG_NON_COHERENT`), `QUERYBUF`, `EXPBUF`, then
   `close()`. The exported dma-bufs keep the memory alive after close
   (`src/surface.c`).
2. On the surface's first decode, `capture_buffer_bind()` sees existing
   backing and sets `ctx->capture_memory = V4L2_MEMORY_DMABUF`.
   `capture_attach_backing()` dups the exported fds onto the CAPTURE
   queue (`src/context.c`). In-context default capture memory is
   otherwise MMAP; this contract does not change that default.
3. CPU access maps the dma-buf with `mmap` and **no**
   `DMA_BUF_IOCTL_SYNC` / begin-cpu-access:
   - unbound surfaces: `v4l2r_surface_view()` maps `backing->dmabuf_fd`
   - bound DMABUF capture: `v4l2r_surface_capture_view()` maps
     `capture->dmabuf_fd`
   - `v4l2r_DeriveImage()` maps `view.dmabuf_fd[0]`
   - `v4l2r_GetImage` / `v4l2r_PutImage` request `need_maps` through
     `v4l2r_surface_view()`
4. `capture_wait_readers()` `POLLOUT` on an exported dma-buf waits for
   reservation fences (GPU readers). That is not cache maintenance.

This path is cache-safe at pin K **only because** the exporter allocated
coherent mmap. After long-uptime fragmentation, the ~13 MiB physically
contiguous AVD plane still fails (`dma alloc of size 13664256 failed`).
CREATE_BUFS `-ENOMEM` is now `VA_STATUS_ERROR_ALLOCATION_FAILED` (PR #92,
`tests/early-export-backing.c`). Playback recovery remains #49 / companion
#22.

## Why mmap cache hints are not a contract

Three distinct requirements: mapping permission, cache visibility, and
absence of in-flight readers. Satisfying one does not satisfy the others.

At pin K:

- [`init_buffer_cache_hints()`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/blob/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea/drivers/media/common/videobuf2/videobuf2-core.c)
  sets `skip_cache_sync_on_prepare` and `skip_cache_sync_on_finish` for
  `VB2_MEMORY_DMABUF`. The importer assigns cache sync to the exporter.
- [`vb2_dc_prepare` / `vb2_dc_finish`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/blob/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea/drivers/media/common/videobuf2/videobuf2-dma-contig.c)
  return immediately when those skip flags are set, and also when the
  buffer is coherent. Cache maintenance for non-coherent MMAP therefore
  runs only on the **allocating** MMAP queue, which early-export closes.
- Export [`map` / `detach`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/blob/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea/drivers/media/common/videobuf2/videobuf2-dma-contig.c)
  use `DMA_ATTR_SKIP_CPU_SYNC`. The comments assume device-coherent
  memory even if `non_coherent_mem` was set at alloc time.
- [`vb2_dc_dmabuf_ops_begin_cpu_access` / `end_cpu_access`](https://github.com/AsahiLinux/linux/blob/94fb23346d522edf53722357c426a3e58030beea/drivers/media/common/videobuf2/videobuf2-dma-contig.c)
  return 0 with no cache operations. `DMA_BUF_IOCTL_SYNC` in userspace
  cannot repair those no-op callbacks.

Patch 0001's noncontiguous alloc is reached from the MMAP queue's
prepare/finish path when `V4L2_MEMORY_FLAG_NON_COHERENT` is set. Chrome
early-export does not keep that queue; the live decoder imports DMABUF.
O already records that unknown or cacheable exported backing is blocked
at this pin pending its own synchronization fix.

## Legal versus illegal next steps

| Option | Owner | Verdict |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Request `V4L2_MEMORY_FLAG_NON_COHERENT` because CAPTURE advertises `V4L2_BUF_CAP_SUPPORTS_MMAP_CACHE_HINTS` | driver `backing_alloc` | **Illegal.** Rejected by PR #92. Hints on the throwaway fd do not bind the importer or CPU maps. |
| Wrap CPU maps with `DMA_BUF_IOCTL_SYNC` on the current exporter | driver `surface.c` / `image.c` | **Illegal** at pin K (no-op begin/end CPU-access). |
| Keep the throwaway allocator fd open so original-queue prepare/finish still run | driver lifetime | **Insufficient.** Live decode imports DMABUF on another queue (`skip_cache_sync_*`); exporter hooks remain no-ops. |
| Refuse CPU maps / DeriveImage on non-coherent export; GPU import only | driver | **Insufficient** at pin K. The GPU importer also relies on the exporter for cache visibility. |
| Kernel: implement real exporter `begin_cpu_access` / `end_cpu_access`, and stop skipping CPU sync on non-coherent export; and/or allocate noncontiguous memory that is not cacheable-MMAP | companion #52 experimental candidate | **Prerequisite** for any future userspace `NON_COHERENT`. Requires `needs:kernel-approval`. Do not edit shipped `0001`. |
| Userspace stays coherent until that kernel identity is reviewed | driver (current) | **Required fallback.** |

Userspace may request `NON_COHERENT` later only if **all** hold:

1. The CAPTURE queue advertises `V4L2_BUF_CAP_SUPPORTS_MMAP_CACHE_HINTS`.
2. The loaded kernel identity is **not** pin K: exporter CPU-access
   callbacks actually maintain cache (or the allocation is
   noncontiguous and not cacheable-MMAP). Record that identity.
3. Offline tests cover the ordering matrix below against that identity.
4. Coherent CREATE_BUFS remains the fallback when any of 1–3 is missing.
   Do not retry the same fd without the flag after a non-coherent
   failure (that would reintroduce contig CMA). Trying another
   enumerated decoder after `-ENOMEM` is enumeration, not a retry loop.

## Proposed later test matrix (not implemented here)

Ticket AC: offline tests of the complete cache/CPU/importer ordering
matrix wait until this contract is accepted. The cases a later
implementation PR must wrap, without hardware frames:

| Case | Required observation |
| --- | --- |
| Coherent CREATE_BUFS `count = 1` `V4L2_MEMORY_MMAP` | Success path; no count=0 probe. Already in `tests/early-export-backing.c`. |
| CREATE_BUFS `-ENOMEM` | `VA_STATUS_ERROR_ALLOCATION_FAILED`. Already merged. |
| CREATE_BUFS `-EINVAL` | `VA_STATUS_ERROR_OPERATION_FAILED`, not misclassified as OOM. Already merged. |
| Hints advertised, exporter contract **absent** (pin K behavior) | Allocating CREATE_BUFS still coherent; no `NON_COHERENT` flag. |
| Hints advertised, exporter contract **present** (new kernel identity) | Allocating CREATE_BUFS sets `NON_COHERENT`; no silent coherent retry on the same fd. |
| Allocate → EXPBUF → close allocator → import as DMABUF | Import uses the exported fd; allocator queue is not the decode queue. |
| Decode-complete → CPU map (`view` / Derive / Get / Put) | CPU access is ordered after device write using the real exporter contract, not a no-op SYNC. |
| Decode-complete → GPU attach | Importer cache visibility is the exporter's duty; a GPU-only skip of CPU maps is not sufficient proof. |
| Exporter contract missing at runtime | Fall back to coherent; do not fail the surface solely because hints were advertised. |

Do not fake hardware success. Do not treat software fallback or a wrap-test
flag assertion as Chromium qualification.
